skill.name: html-structure-validate
skill.description: Validate generated HTML5 pages for required document structure, tag closure, metadata, content containers, and reportable errors before publishing.
skill.summary: Runs structural HTML checks and writes a validation report for pipeline gating.

content.value_statement: Generated HTML can pass review while still missing critical document structure. This skill checks HTML5 elements, tag closure, content containers, and validation reports before the pipeline continues.
actual_capabilities: Checks for required DOCTYPE, html, head, body, title, stylesheet, and content container elements.
Validates tag closure, nesting, headings, lists, links, images, and tables using a structure validation tool.
Writes a validation report with pass, fail, warning, error, and summary data.
Supports strict mode where warnings can fail the validation workflow.
Stops downstream processing when structural validation fails and reports actionable error details.
Records page and chapter metadata in the validation report.
limitations: Requires the existing validate_html.py tool and expected Calypso project paths.
Checks HTML structure, not visual layout, browser rendering, or accessibility compliance.
Relative paths and output locations must match the surrounding pipeline conventions.
It does not repair invalid HTML automatically.

use_cases.title: Gate AI page generation
use_cases.description: Validate each generated page before consolidation so malformed markup does not enter later publishing steps.

use_cases.title: Check frontend markup
use_cases.description: Review generated HTML files for required document elements, nested tags, headings, lists, and basic links.

use_cases.title: Document page quality
use_cases.description: Produce a repeatable validation report for generated book pages before handoff or review.

prompt_templates.title: Validate one generated page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use html-structure-validate on output/chapter_02/page_artifacts/page_16/04_page_16.html and save the report beside the page.

prompt_templates.title: Run strict validation
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate this page with strict_mode enabled. Treat warnings as failures and list every blocking issue.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a failed report
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the structure validation report for page 16. Explain each failure and identify the HTML section that needs correction.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a chapter workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate every generated HTML page in chapter 2, summarize pass and fail status, and identify any shared structural pattern.

output_examples.input: A generated HTML page with a missing title and no stylesheet link.
output_examples.output: Validation fails. The report lists missing title and stylesheet link as structural errors and recommends fixing the head section.

output_examples.input: A valid page with a viewport warning only.
output_examples.output: Validation passes in normal mode and records one warning for later review.

output_examples.input: A chapter where several pages have unmatched list items.
output_examples.output: The chapter summary highlights the repeated list issue and blocks consolidation until the pages are corrected.

best_practices: Validate pages immediately after generation, before consolidation or visual review.
Keep report files beside page artifacts so failures are easy to trace.
Use strict mode for release candidates or high-risk publishing workflows.
anti_patterns: Do not treat warnings as fixes; review them before final publication.
Do not run validation from an unexpected directory without checking relative paths.
Do not use this skill as the only review for accessibility or layout quality.

faq.question: What does this skill validate?
faq.answer: It validates HTML5 document structure, required tags, tag closure, basic content containers, and report output.

faq.question: Does it fix broken HTML?
faq.answer: No. It reports structural problems so a user or generation step can correct them.

faq.question: Can warnings block the pipeline?
faq.answer: Yes. Enable strict mode when warnings should fail validation.

faq.question: Does it check CSS rendering?
faq.answer: No. It checks links to stylesheets, but it does not render pages or inspect visual layout.

faq.question: What tools does it require?
faq.answer: It expects the validate_html.py tool from the surrounding Calypso toolchain.

faq.question: Where is the report saved?
faq.answer: The skill saves a structure validation report in the page artifact output directory.
